turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a call at 4:40, so we'll keep this short. Owen found out about that zero on his phone in the middle of class, so tell me who decided it, and when.
"Heard my points." I asked you a question, Hale: who entered the zero, and did anyone speak to Owen first?
With respect, this is exactly what lawyers do. Make noise until the facts go away.
I'm writing down that you said that. You keep mentioning facts, Hale, so put one on this desk, starting with why my son found out on his phone.
Your son cheated, and you're teaching him that Mom can make it disappear.
Owen does not lie, and he wrote that essay. You've called my son a cheater without one document in front of you, Hale. When this is done I'm walking straight to the principal's office.
